rationale: Price is sitting at 85% of today's range after a sharp intraday recovery from the $836 low, now consolidating tightly around $876 with the last five 1-minute candles showing diminishing range and no clear directional momentum. The stock gapped down ~2% on strong earnings (beat on both EPS and revenue), which is a mixed signal — the gap-down on good news suggests distribution or sell-the-news dynamics, yet the recovery from $836 to $876 shows significant buying interest. With price near the 9-EMA ($872) but well above VWAP ($858), the risk/reward for either direction is unclear at this consolidation point, and two working orders already commit ~6% of buying power.
